component.name: ASTRA-MED Lunar Crew Health Monitoring System
component.summary: Autonomous physiological, habitat, radiation, and EVA spacesuit telemetry suite for lunar missions

description.p: Developed for the NASA International Space Apps Challenge 2026, ASTRA-MED is a modular microservice system written in Rust for continuous monitoring of astronaut health, lunar habitat environment, radiation exposure, and EVA spacesuit telemetry.
